steps_note: Each row is one stage of AnalysisImaging.fit_from in the library's own lazy order; the rows sum to total_step_by_step. JAX rows are successive differences of jitted prefixes (params -> stage k), so XLA fusion can move work across a boundary and a small negative row is noise; numba rows time each cached property on first access, per instance, and report the median over the warm instances.
